findings.evidence: Each clarification response contains ... carried-over open questions, and the next 2–3 questions. Step 3 likewise mandates 2–3 questions, without an exception when exactly one consequential decision remains.
findings.fix: Change both instructions to ask one to three consequential questions, explicitly allowing a single question when only one unresolved decision remains. Preserve the existing generation and stalled-interview exit conditions.

findings.evidence: The prd-final assertion requires: 'if that score differs from the stated 92, both are shown'. SKILL.md line 42 requires both scores only when the recomputed advisory score is below 90, so a compliant PRD showing only its recomputed score of 95 would fail this assertion.
findings.fix: Align the assertion with the protocol: require the independently recomputed advisory score, and require comparison with the supplied score only when the recomputed score is below 90.
